// 01 — About

The Person Behind
The Work

I'm Kenth James P. Reyes, an aspiring digital professional currently focused on General Virtual Assistance, Social Media Management, Website Development, and UI/UX Design — still building my expertise and continuously improving in each of these areas. I'm currently pursuing my Bachelor's Degree in BSIT (Bachelor of Science in Information Technology), and I bring both academic knowledge and real-world project experience to every endeavor.

My work spans from building functional management systems, designing clean user interfaces, leveraging powerful AI tools for content creation, and growing digital brand presence across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. I also use Canva for professional graphic design and social media editing. I also bring experience from the government sector, which has sharpened my discipline and attention to detail.

"Building meaningful client relationships and delivering work that speaks for itself — that's what drives me every single day."
